ops.title: Preserve Install behavior when local Git config is absent
ops.description: Review of d93a643b9843c8f695a7ecab2829c5ffb8451129: internal/gitcmd/gitcmd.go:900-902 and internal/sync/install.go:84-90. A valid repository may lack its local config file. With upstream defined only in GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL, git remote succeeds, git config --local --get-all -z returns exit 1 with empty stdout/stderr (accepted by ConfigGetAll), but the new --list -z returns exit 128 with ENOENT. Install now fails before its global-remote fallback; the parent implementation creates the local config and wires the remote. Next step: preserve the empty-local-config behavior in ConfigLocal and add the missing-local-file variation to TestInstallWiresARemoteOnlyGlobalConfigNames. Evidence: /Users/yasyf/.vcache/scratch/ccn-efficiency/review-d93a643b-8sqls_5u/missing-local-receipt.txt. Only small git probes were run; no Go tests/builds were run. Implementation, CI, and affected-case verification remain pending.

ops.text: A valid repository with no local config and a global-only upstream installs the same fetch, HEAD push, cc-notes push, and reflog settings as the parent implementation.
Malformed or unreadable local configuration still reports an error, and an already wired repository retains one local config read without per-key reads or remote enumeration.
Required CI passes and a fresh absent-config affected-case check confirms installation and the subsequent idempotent no-op.
